SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: Priya Nandakumar, MD (fictional)
Indication: Surveillance colonoscopy.
Procedure: The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum, identified by the appendiceal orifice and ileocecal valve. Preparation was good.
Findings: In the sigmoid colon at 25 cm there was a 6 mm sessile polyp. This polyp was removed en bloc with a cold snare and retrieved.
A second polyp, 3 mm and flat, was seen in the sigmoid colon at 30 cm. Cold forceps biopsies were taken from it, and it was left in place.
The second polyp was not snared because of its size.
The remainder of the colon was normal.
Impression: Two sigmoid polyps: the 6 mm polyp removed with a cold snare; the 3 mm polyp biopsied and left in place.
